run_make_lmdb_sizes: run the script to generate metadata.npz files for load balancing a DataLoader from an LMDB dataset
run_get_data: run get_data to extract natoms and neighbor counts from a single dataset index
run_make_lmdb_sizes_function: run make_lmdb_sizes to parallelize extraction of atom and neighbor counts across all dataset samples
run_get_lmdb_sizes_parser: run get_lmdb_sizes_parser to build an argparse parser with data-path and num-workers arguments
review_make_lmdb_sizes: review the make_lmdb_sizes function to understand how it saves natoms and neighbors as sorted numpy arrays
